messages:
Amelia: Quick sync — proposing a 'concierge invite' pilot to improve DP signal quality vs volume. Goal: 10 active partners, 4-week engagement with structured feedback.

Sam: +1. What's the qualification cutoff? our current funnel adds a lot of noise.

Amelia: Thinking: either existing prod usage > 10k queries/mo OR partner commits ~8 hrs/week ops time. Also must agree to weekly SLA'd feedback review meeting.

Diego: Suggest a measurable success metric: 'time-to-first-action' < 48h after onboarding AND >=5 active sessions in week 2.

Nora: Incentives idea: credits + custom model config + 1:1 onboarding help from Solutions Eng.

Amelia: Plan = two tracks: 'concierge' (high-touch, limited seats) and 'self-serve beta' (wider, lighter). Concierge seats = 10 for Q2.

Sam: Rollout checklist?

Amelia: Short checklist below:
```text
- Recruit 10 partners (sales/AM outreach)
- NDA + intake form (legal)
- Onboard infra (dedicated/private pin options)
- 1:1 kickoff + baseline evals
- Weekly 30m feedback + prompt harness
- Regression alerts + automatic rollback policy
```

Diego: For feedback loops capture: structured evals (per partner prompt sets), qual notes, performance traces, token-cost deltas. Make sure eval IDs attach to issue.

Nora: Add onboarding success criteria: 'first 3 convo flows instrumented' and 'partner-run eval passes >=3/5 on quality threshold' before we escalate requests.

Amelia: Success metrics we'll track: partner activation rate, 4-week retention, feature adoption (per-route), avg latency delta, unit cost change, and qualitative CSAT.

Sam: Scope negotiation guardrails?

Amelia: Non-negotiable: no risky prod schema changes or open-data exposures. Negotiable: feature priority order and timeline. All partner asks must be captured in a single PRD with acceptance tests and rollback plan.

Diego: Also add automatic feedback routing: JIRA labels + eval id so Eng gets a tight loop. Redwood Optimize should synth weekly summary (quality vs cost) per partner.

Amelia: Timeline proposal: recruitment + NDA = w1-2; onboard = w3; 4-week pilot = w4-w7; end-of-pilot review = w8.

Nora: Do we need reserved capacity? @Sam can you confirm dedicated pool sizing for 10 partners and fallback to hosted variants?

Sam: I'll audit current GPU pool this afternoon. If not enough headroom, we default to nightly burst + route-throttling policies; will flag any SLO gaps. :thumbsup:

dp-bot: invite-form submitted by Sales (ticket #DP-482).

Amelia: Next actions: Nora to draft invite email + intake form by EOD Wed; Sam to confirm capacity by Thu; Diego to prepare eval harness and prompt set by Fri. I'll assemble a partner-facing one-pager and intake checklist.

Amelia: If you can take your assigned item, react with :raised_hands:. Thanks!
